study type: Experimental animal study (in vivo pig model and in vitro cell studies)
outcome: Pathogen adhesion to intestinal epithelial cells
In situ abundance of E. coli
cohort: The study included 24 cesarean-delivered newborn pigs.
finding: While 2'-FL inhibited in vitro adhesion of E coli F18 to epithelial cells, it had limited effects on preventing diarrhea and improving mucosal health in newborn pigs challenged with E coli F18.
